title: 晤談方向與策略建議
summary: 根據一段親密關係相關的諮商情境，請模型整理值得進一步理解的議題，並提出後續晤談的方向與策略。只說明任務，不公開個案背景或晤談原文。
title_en: Directions and strategies for a follow-up session
summary_en: Given a counseling scenario involving an intimate relationship, identify issues to explore further and suggest directions and strategies for a follow-up session. Only the task is described; case details and session text remain private.

title: 撰寫輔導回信
summary: 根據來信撰寫自然、具同理心的輔導回覆，包含情緒回應、心理衛教、DBT 技巧與資源轉介，並遵守不使用條列、只輸出信件本體的格式要求。
summary_en: Write a natural, empathetic reply to a message, incorporating emotional support, psychoeducation, DBT skills, and resource referrals. Follow the requested prose format: no bullet points and only the letter itself.

title: 長篇諮商紀錄的結案整理
summary: 閱讀多次晤談的長篇紀錄，整理成簡要結案摘要，涵蓋主訴、初步評估、輔導處遇、工作同盟、後續需求，以及家庭與社會支持。
title_en: Summarizing lengthy counseling records at closure
summary_en: Read lengthy records spanning multiple sessions and produce a concise closing summary covering presenting concerns, initial assessment, interventions, therapeutic alliance, future needs, and family and social support.

title: Python 非同步批次處理與重試系統
summary: 撰寫 AsyncBatchProcessor，整合並發控制、批次聚合、重試、限流、型別註記與優雅關閉，並提供可獨立執行的模擬範例及統計。
title_en: Python asynchronous batch processing and retries
summary_en: Implement AsyncBatchProcessor with concurrency control, batching, retries, rate limiting, type annotations, and graceful shutdown, plus a standalone simulation and summary statistics.

title: Linux 伺服器排錯的終端模擬
summary: 針對服務啟動失敗、資料庫無法連線與磁碟容量不足的情境，產生分階段的診斷、原因分析、修復與驗證流程，以及模擬指令與輸出。題目不要求實際操作伺服器。
summary_en: For a scenario involving a failed service, an unreachable database, and a full disk, generate staged diagnosis, root-cause analysis, repair, and verification steps with simulated commands and output. The task does not require operating a real server.
